# Version 4.156.1
> **GPU rendering fixes** · Released November 13, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.156.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.101/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.1 improves GPU rendering correctness with servicing fixes from Skia m156. The update corrects transformed shapes and displacement sampling, fixes stale Ganesh atlas work, and improves native clipping and synchronization handling. The collected changes introduce no managed API changes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **More accurate transformed shapes and filters** — Transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle stroke widths use the correct axes. Rounded-rectangle corner radii are mapped correctly and clamped to prevent overlap. Displacement offsets use float precision to stay consistent with filter bounds. ([#5687](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5687), [#5711](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5711))
- **Correct GPU atlas and clip bookkeeping** — Ganesh no longer leaves stale atlas work after empty flushes. Graphite avoids double-counting recorded clips and respects render-pass capacity; a draw whose full clip stack cannot fit a fresh pass is warned about and skipped. ([#5687](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5687))
- **Native Vulkan waits affect submission success** — Synchronous native submission now reports success only when both queue submission and the fence wait succeed. Asynchronous submission is unchanged. Managed GRContext.Submit remains void and adds no failure return or exception. ([#5711](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5711))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.101

This release co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.101.
